headline: President Biden created an emergency board to look into a labor dispute between New Jersey Transit and its train engineers' union.
what_it_does: This order sets up a federal emergency board to investigate a dispute between New Jersey Transit's rail operations and its locomotive engineers. The engineers are represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers and Trainmen. Boards like this usually study the dispute and suggest ways to settle it. The title does not give details about the dispute or the board's rules.

who_it_affects.how: Their labor dispute with the railroad will be reviewed by a federal emergency board.
The agency's dispute with its engineers will be investigated by the board.
The board's review may affect whether and how the dispute disrupts commuter rail service.
